history: Retain each failed criterion with the exact operation or dependency defect, changed modules and reassessment. Never retry an unchanged partition.

items.expect: The request and contract files are valid and present.

onFail.instruction: Ask for the malformed request field.

items.expect: All declared input files match their digests.

onFail.instruction: Ask for the missing or changed contract artifact.

items.expect: Every frozen operation belongs to exactly one valid module and no new operation appears.

onFail.instruction: Name the omitted, duplicated or invented operation and repartition only affected modules.

items.expect: Every module carries the required goal, boundary and proof data.

onFail.instruction: Repair the named module field from frozen contract evidence.

items.expect: Dependencies are valid, acyclic and identical in plan and units.

onFail.instruction: Correct the named dependency or cycle without changing module membership.

items.expect: The response binds the request revision.
Output artifacts are scoped and digest-bound.
Observations reference declared acceptance criteria and evidence.
The architecture decision and stack model are available.

onFail.instruction: Ask for the exact missing architecture artifact.

items.expect: Required file and Git inspection capabilities are available.

onFail.instruction: Name the unavailable capability and unverified boundary.
Retry only the failed read or artifact write once.

stopWhen: Return done only when every criterion passes. After two failed feedback rounds, return mismatch with concrete unassigned operations or dependency defects and no partial plan.
